Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 24-Dec-2024 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
FIFTH SEMESTER B.Tech. (COMPUTER SCIENCE AND ENGINEERING) EXAMINATIONS - DECEMBER 2024 / JANUARY  
  2025  
  SUBJECT: CSE 3124/CSE_3124 - COMPUTER NETWORKS  
  
  
  COMPUTER NETWORKS [CSE 3124]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                         Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1A)               Suppose N packets arrive simultaneously to a link at which no packets are currently being           (4)  
  transmitted or queued. Each packet is of length L and the link has transmission rate R. What is the  
  average queuing delay for the N packets? Now suppose that N such packets arrive to the link every  
  LN/R seconds. What is the average queuing delay of a packet?  
1B)               Suppose Host A wants to send a large file to Host B. The path from Host A to Host B has three               (4)  
  $$links, of rates R1 = 400 kbps, R2 = 2.5 Mbps, and R3 = 1.5 Mbps.$$  
  i) Assuming no other traffic in the network, what is the throughput for the file transfer?  
  ii) Suppose the file is 4 million bytes. Dividing the file size by the throughput, roughly how long will it  
  take to transfer the file to Host B?  
  iii)) Repeat (i) and (ii), but now with R2 reduced to 50 kbps.  
1C)               Why are standards important for protocols? Explain.                                                         (2)  
2A)               Consider an HTTP client that wants to retrieve a Web document at a given URL. The IP address of (4)  
  the HTTP server is initially unknown. What transport and application-layer protocols besides HTTP  
  are needed in this scenario?  
2B)               Evaluate the role of DNS in maintaining reliable and efficient access to web services. What                 (4)  
  potential vulnerabilities exist within DNS, and how might these impact the reliability of Internet  
  services?  
2C)               Which is more reliable TCP based socket program or UDP based socket program? Justify your                   (2)  
  answer.  
3A)               Compare and contrast the stop-and-wait and pipelined protocols with neat diagrams.                          (4)  
3B)               Discuss the steps involved in TCP client to establish a TCP connection with the TCP server. Also,           (4)  
  discuss how TCP manages its connection through the following: TCP three-way handshake with  
  neat diagram.  
3C)               Discuss the importance of receiver window in TCP to handle flow control between sender A and                (2)  
  receiver B with neat diagram.  
4A)               A large number of consecutive IP addresses are available starting at 198.16.0.0. Suppose that four (4)  
  organizations, A, B, C, and D, request 4000, 2000, 4000, and 8000 addresses, respectively, and in  
  that order. For each of these, give the first IP address assigned, the last IP address assigned, and  
  the mask in the w.x.y.z/s notation.  
4B)               A class B network address 130.50.0.0 is submitted as follows. The last 10 bits of the host id are           (4)  
  allotted for host number and the remaining 6 bits are reserved for subnet number.  
  i) How many subnets and number of hosts in each subnet are possible with above scheme?  
  ii) What is the starting addresses of 1st and 4th subnets?  
  Page 1 of 2

4C)   A network has subnet mask 255.255.255.254. Determine the maximum number of hosts in this             (2)  
  network. Also determine the broadcast address of this network.  
5A)   Critique the use of CSMA/CD in Ethernet networks and discuss its limitations in high-traffic or      (4)  
  wireless environments. Suggest an alternative protocol and justify its advantages in these  
  scenarios.  
5B)   Interpret the concept of framing within the Link Layer, and analyze how effective framing techniques (4)  
  contribute to error management and data synchronization. Provide a real-world example to support  
  your analysis.  
5C)   In a CRC error-detection system with generator polynomial G(x) = x3 + x + 1 and data bit string      (2)  
  D(x) = 110100111, calculate the CRC code and discuss how the remainder verifies data integrity.  
  Show all intermediate steps.  
  
  
  -----End-----
